fusions.name: Cavern Bleat
fusions.desc: Bleats a shrill note that echoes ahead of you in a 4-tile cone, dealing 12 resonating damage and stunning everything caught for 1 second.

fusions.name: Small Red Bite
fusions.desc: Bites the target for 4 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Ledge Flit
fusions.desc: Flits you 2 tiles from where you stood and raises your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Dark Roost
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
